Morikā
Poetess. q. by Gadādhara in his Rasikajīvana, BORI. D.

. mentioned in a verse ascribed to Dhanadadeva in Śp. 107, 24 (mA gaccha pramadApriya …). 102, 6 (likhati na gaNayati …). Sbh. v.. 1050. 1053. 1072. 1396.
See Poona Ori.
(1873) 75; Vijjikā in the J. Myth. Soci., XXIV, p. 156. Sanskrit an. Prakrit Poetesses, J. Myth. Soci., XXV. p.. 58-59; Sanskrit Poetess Vijjikā an. Morikā by J. B. Chaudhuri, IHQ.
